content:
Laredo police officers spent part of Halloween weekend bringing treats to children in foster care who could not go trick-or-treating.

Officers from the Laredo Police Department's Yankee platoon, organized by Sgt. Jose G. Hernandez and Sgt. Jose A. Lopez, visited a foster placement home in Laredo and delivered treat bags filled with candy and Halloween goodies, along with pizza for the children and staff, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Cynthia Vasquez, who works with the organization, told the paper many of the children did not get to go trick-or-treating.

Officer Jose Angel Lopez told the paper, "We are all part of the Laredo community. We do it out of love."

The visit was part of the department's community outreach, which also includes its annual toy drive.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, reporting on the officers' Halloween weekend visit on November 2, 2026.

title: Laredo officers bring Halloween treats to foster children
